label: U.S. legislative and political-finance estate
domain: Congressional rosters, financial disclosures, periodic transactions, committees, campaigns, and money streams
scope: House and Senate denominators, annual disclosures, PTRs, campaign committees, FEC contributions and disbursements, exact business entities, federal recipients, temporal joins, and explicit nulls.
fog: temporal order and explicit no-crossing rows

next_acquisition.operation: acquire both chambers symmetrically and preserve all nonmatches
next_acquisition.decisive_output: chamber-complete disclosure-to-entity-to-money-stream matrix with dates and nulls

boundary: A disclosed interest, campaign transaction, vote, and federal award cannot be collapsed into a causal claim.
